chapter: Compositions, singers and the end of the big band
title: Carol Tucker and Laura Washington
summary: He hired Tucker in Chicago and she died young of lung illness; Laura Washington came from Birmingham.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Well, Carol Tucker was another girl vocalist. You know, she was a young girl I got out of Chicago. She came back-stage at the Regal Theatre. This, and then for me to hear her sing. And then, I decided to take her along. She was beautiful. I was going from Chicago to Detroit and she met me in Detroit
cause she had to get herself together. And then from there, to New York at the Lincoln Hotel.

Now, I'm not sure of the time but while she was at the Lincoln, she developed a malignant lung, sick. She had to turn around and go back to Chicago. Not too long after that, she died. A young girl, passed, beautiful. Had a beautiful voice.
She had recorded 'Truly By The Things We Do'. That was a recording. That was a good number.
And then, I brought Laura Washington up from Birmingham later. Yeah. They both sing about the same side by the same style.
